items.title: Stop Using Markdown Files. Are HTML Plans Better?
items.description:
Anthropic developer Derek wrote about it last week. Stop using Markdown files for planning output. Use HTML instead.

HTML plans are 63% more token expensive than Markdown. The output is prettier, more visual, easier to share, and you can embed previews, color palettes, and interactive elements directly in the plan.
